data.name: NOI Casa Atacama
data.address: Tocopilla 8E, San Pedro de Atacama, Antofagasta, Chile
data.description:
Surrounded by volcanoes and national parks in the Atacama Desert, this refined ecolodge is a 7-minute walk from the long-standing Church of San Pedro de Atacama and 3 km from pre-Columbian archaeological site Pukará de Quitor.
Featuring handcrafted furnishings and organic toiletries, the relaxed rooms have free Wi-Fi, safes, fans, sitting areas and terraces. Suites add pool views, while upgraded suites offer fireplaces. There are no TVs.
Complimentary amenities include parking, and a breakfast buffet served in an upscale restaurant. There's also an open-air bar beside an outdoor pool, and a terrace, as well as a spa. Excursions are available.
